Each restriction is YES when a currently applicable mandatory voting condition is stated, NO when explicitly waived or no such condition is stated in this notice, UNKNOWN when relevant terms are genuinely ambiguous or contradictory. NO means not stated/waived, not a guarantee of legal absence outside the supplied text. Preserve uncertainties. A condition mandatory for the particular holder described counts as YES; an optional service does not.

share_blocking: submitting voting instructions immobilises shares or prevents transfer.
